title: Luxury Small-Group Niagara Falls Day Tour from Toronto with Hornblower Cruise
includes: Admission to Hornblower Niagara Cruises boat tour
Pickup and drop-off at all major downtown Toronto hotels
All taxes, fees and handling charges
Professional tour guide and separate driver
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

To ensure everyone has a great experience, please note that this tour involves 10 to 15 minutes of walking at several stops, including an uphill stretch from the boat dock. Guests should also be comfortable stepping in and out of our vehicle (two steps) unassisted. Please advise us ahead of time if you have mobility concerns.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
With an average of just 8 guests and a maximum of 15 guests, our small group tours of Niagara Falls allow more time for sightseeing. No long queues! We’re unique in offering both a dedicated driver and a licenced guide. Our award-winning tours are packed full of photo stops. Canada’s captivating Falls are a world wonder! Be dazzled by the thundering Falls on the Hornblower boat cruise. Be wowed by the riverside vistas, Whirlpool Rapids, and Floral Clock along the scenic Niagara Parkway enroute to 
enchanting Niagara-on-the-Lake. Truly memorable!
